test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which Article of the Constitution of India enshrines one of the Directive Principles of State Policy which lays down that ‘the State shall take steps to organise village panchayats and endow them with such powers and authority as may be necessary to enable them to function as units of self-government’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 40**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Article 40** of the Constitution of India enshrines one of the **Directive Principles of State Policy**.
 
• It states that "the State shall take steps to organise village panchayats and endow them with such powers and authority as may be necessary to enable them to function as units of self-government."
 
• This directive aims at **promoting local self-governance and empowering rural areas**.
 
• Article 40 is part of **Part IV** of the Indian Constitution, which outlines the Directive Principles of State Policy.
 
• These principles are fundamental in the governance of the country, intended to be applied by the government in making laws.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Directive Principles of State Policy are guidelines for the framing of laws by the government. They **are not enforceable by any court**, but they are considered **fundamental in the governance of the country**.
 
• The Constitution of India was adopted on **26th November 1949** and came into effect on **26th January 1950**.
 
• The Constitution aims to establish India as a sovereign, socialist, secular, and democratic republic.
 
• It assures its citizens justice, equality, and liberty, and endeavors to promote fraternity among them.
 
• Article 40 is among the various articles in the Constitution that aim to promote social and economic welfare and to ensure a just society.
